commits.patch:
diff --git a/lib/mprintf.c b/lib/mprintf.c
--- a/lib/mprintf.c
+++ b/lib/mprintf.c
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@
 #define BUFFSIZE 326 /* buffer for long-to-str and float-to-str calcs, should
                         fit negative DBL_MAX (317 letters) */
 #define MAX_PARAMETERS 128 /* number of input arguments */
-#define MAX_SEGMENTS   128 /* number of output segments */
+#define MAX_SEGMENTS   129 /* number of output segments */
 
 /* Lower-case digits. */
 const unsigned char Curl_ldigits[] = "0123456789abcdef";

coupling: The first edit raises the number of permitted output segments from 128 to 129; at that commit the formatf output array still uses MAX_SEGMENTS and grows with the limit. The later edit sizes that array using MAX_PARAMETERS, which is 128. Considered alone against the original limit, the later edit leaves the array size unchanged. Together, parsefmt accepts a 129th segment and writes it into a 128-element stack array. The repair must reconcile the parser's accepted segment count with formatf's storage capacity across the two commits.
